title: Recall Monitor: FDA & CPSC New-Recall Feed
desc: New product recalls from every federal source in one only-new feed: FDA enforcement reports (food, drugs, devices) and CPSC consumer-product recalls, keyword and firm filtered, one normalized row per recall. Keyless public APIs. From $2 per 1,000.

title: Mention Monitor: Hacker News, Mastodon, Bluesky, YouTube
desc: Watch keywords on Hacker News, hashtags and accounts on Mastodon, accounts on Bluesky, and YouTube channels; get only the new public posts since your last run as normalized rows with author, text, link, time, and engagement. Official public APIs and feeds, no keys. From $1.20 per 1,000.

title: Hiring Signal Tracker: Greenhouse, Lever & Ashby Job Changes
desc: Watch any list of company job boards on Greenhouse, Lever and Ashby and get one row per change: job opened, closed, reposted, or retitled, with title, department, location, seniority, days open, and link, plus a free per-board hiring-velocity summary. Official APIs, no keys. From $2.50 per 1,000.
